environment: Local Vite development build, Codex in-app browser, same populated Cycle 1 Turn 3
notes: Frame pacing is measured using R3F frame deltas, not GPU timer queries.
Draw calls and triangles include the entire composer, with its existing shadows, bloom and grading.
Classic and Neon measurements were taken from the same running game without changing the card state.
These samples are capped by the display refresh and do not establish performance on low-end hardware.
